face.name: 转生
face.text: 消灭一个随从，然后将其复活，并具有所有生命值。
face.flavorText: 这和出生时没什么两样，除了你生下来就是个成年人，除了你一秒钟之前还是个死人。

face.name: Reincarnate
face.text: Destroy a minion, then return it to life with full Health.
face.flavorText: It's like birth, except you're an adult and you were just dead a second ago.

face.name: 转生

face.name: Reincarnate

face.text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Resummon this minion."

face.name: Spirit Echo
face.text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Return this to your hand."
face.flavorText: I guess you can say they’re… “soul survivors.”

face.text: 恢复 4点生命值。在本回合可以重复使用。
face.flavorText: 隔汤有眼！

face.name: Witch's Brew
face.text: Restore 4 Health. Repeatable this turn.
face.flavorText: The swill has eyes!

face.flavorText: ……有一只小小的松鼠受命前去击败恶龙，它在土灵朋友的帮助下救出了鱼人公主。讲完了。

face.name: Once Upon a Time...
face.text: Summon a random 3-Cost Beast, Dragon, Elemental, and Murloc.
face.flavorText: ...There was a humble little squirrel on a quest to defeat an evil dragon. With the help of its earthen friend, it saved the murloc princess from danger. The end.

face.flavorText: It's just a Tempest Tantrum.

face.flavorText: “长官，目前连续抽到所有小行星的几率约为1/3720！”“少跟我说什么几率！”

face.flavorText: "Sir, the possibility of successfully drawing all of your Asteroids in a row are approximately 3,720:1!" "Never tell me the odds!"

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

rule_sources.policy: Original printed fresh copy, rightmost position; death reactions and capacity precede return.
Live trigger returns the original physical minion; no duplicate.
Repeated Spirit Echo grants return one original physical card, not multiple copies.

policies.resummon: Original base-resummon material captured before destruction; native components/Jade/permanent facts retained, ordinary local buffs reset; no hand-play or Battlecry.
policies.death: Living Spores natural actual death delegates ResurrectMinion; other live/stored trigger captures original base material. Spirit Echo moves one original natural graveyard or current board/deck source.
policies.repeat: Witch Brew HandRepeatSpec(echo=False); ordinary current-turn temporary copies with no Echo-specific one-Mana floor.
policies.draw: Actual previous closed own Elemental hand-play predicate; one normal physical top draw and existing copy_self arrival material.
policies.future_price: Draw first, install original pending turn-start program, consume on next actual own start and apply printed Nature-only original cost modifier until that turn end.
policies.asteroid: Raw base2 plus existing per-card original spell_effect_values; ordinary random enemy SPELL damage and actual CastWhenDrawn/replacement. Original gallery omits dynamic number; raw retained.

uncertainties: Shared reaction, retained intrinsic composite state, arrival copying of draw-cast chains and return/Deathrattle interleaving policies remain local and uncalibrated.
Other Asteroid-number producer cards are separate native consumers; this batch adds the actual Meteor Storm and all Asteroids it generates.
Full Shaman71 source stays unbound; version/hotfix and CN edge calibration deferred.
